description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'StoreLandingController' that manages the store landing page in an e-commerce platform. It includes methods for displaying and saving store landing page content, handling metadata descriptions in multiple languages, and integrating with content and store services.

classes.name: StoreLandingController
classes.description: Controller handling store landing page display and updates in an admin context, with authorization and request mappings.

methods.name: displayStoreLanding
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the store landing page editor, retrieves existing content, and populates the model.

methods.name: saveStoreLanding
methods.description: Processes POST requests to save updates to the store landing page, including content descriptions in multiple languages.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set the current menu context in the model for UI navigation.
